title: The Faraday Form of Conformal Products: Weyl Curvature and Four-Dimensional Einstein Rigidity
summary: Let $(M^n,g)$ carry a conformal product structure whose adapted Weyl connection $D$ preserves orthogonal distributions of ranks $p,q\ge2$. We express the Faraday form $dθ$ directly in terms of the Weyl curvature of $g$. If $S$ is the orthogonal involution determined by the splitting and \[ \mathcal K_W(X)=\sum_i W_{X,e_i}(Se_i) \] for any local orthonormal frame, then \[ (dθ)^\sharp = \frac{n-2}{4(p-1)(q-1)}[\mathcal K_W,S]. \] No Ricci-curvature assumption is required.
